description: Eight signal routes that each open and close on the next clock pulse after you arm them, with a shared fade and a warning output for lit controller buttons

params.text: Sets the fade applied when a route opens or closes, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant
Sets the pulse rate of the WRN outputs while a route is armed to open, 0 to 200ms; at 0ms WRN stays high until the clock arrives and at 200ms it stays low
Sets the pulse rate of the WRN outputs while a route is armed to close, 0 to 200ms; at 0ms WRN stays high until the clock arrives and at 200ms it stays low

inputs.text: The pulse train that times every opening and closing; no route changes state until a pulse arrives here
A trigger here closes all eight routes at once and clears any arming
A trigger here arms that route, and the next clock pulse opens or closes it; a second trigger before that pulse cancels the arming
The signal that route passes; with nothing patched that route's OUT carries the bare fade shape at up to 10V
A trigger here closes that route at once, without waiting for a clock

outputs.text: That route's signal while it is open, faded in and out by the FADE knob
10V for as long as that route is open, 0V otherwise
Pulses at the WA or WR rate while that route is armed and waiting for a clock, and copies that route's IN jack once it is open

notes: nothing happens until a clock is patched: an ARM trigger only arms a route, and the change takes effect on the next pulse at the CLK jack.
menu: Initialize on Start — comes up with every route closed when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming the saved states
Disable Unarm — stops a second ARM trigger from cancelling an arming before its clock pulse arrives
WRN inversion (trigs only) — with the FADE knob fully anticlockwise, holds WRN high while a route is open and drops it to 0V for 100ms each time a trigger passes, instead of copying the input
